# [TFQ-1222] No field of order six, so no finite-field MUB construction at d = 6

## 1. Abstract & Formal Statement

No finite field has six elements, since finite fields have prime-power order; hence the finite-field Weyl-character construction of d+1 MUBs has no instance at d = 6.

### Governing Obligation
This rules out one construction route only; it gives no upper bound on the number of MUBs in C^6 and does not exclude a complete family produced by another construction.

### Witness Audit
lean4/RouteCFourierLandingBypass.lean::dim6_composite_factorization is rfl on 6 = 2*3 and wootters_fields_character_mub_bound_eq_three is rfl on min(3,4) = 3; neither states the field-order theorem. lean4/HilbertMubFamily.lean::exists_finiteField_complex_mub_family builds |F|+1 MUBs for a finite field F of odd characteristic.
